setup.title: Task setup
setup.empty: No turnpoints yet. Click the map to drop the start.
setup.help: Click the map to add turnpoints, drag markers to move, use the + handles to insert. Reorder by dragging the grip, and the optimal route follows.

goal.title: Start & goal
goal.timeNote: Times are shown in the flight's local time and stored in UTC, so they read back correctly in your logbook.
goal.timeNoteWithZone: Times are shown in the flight's local time ({zone}) and stored in UTC, so they read back correctly in your logbook.
goal.help: The goal zone follows the last turnpoint's observation zone: set it (cylinder, line or FAI sector) in the turnpoint list above. Set an arrival height for an elevated goal (taken in the air): the minimum height above the goal terrain to be in goal. Leave it empty for a ground goal.

save.title: Save & share
save.signInHint: Sign in to save tasks. You can still design, import, download and export QR codes without an account.

toasts.signIn: Sign in to save tasks to your account.
toasts.needTask: Add at least a start and a goal first.
toasts.needPublic: Save the task and make it public to share a link.

checks.start: Start drawing your task: click the map to drop the start.

moreTools.noPublic: No public tasks in view. Pan or zoom out.
moreTools.v2Hint: v2: compact code, smallest QR. Elevated goals ride as “fa”.
moreTools.v1Hint: v1: verbose file body, larger QR but widest tool support. Elevated goals ride as “finishAltitude”.
moreTools.qrCaption: Scan into XCTrack or SeeYou Navigator · v{version}
moreTools.cloudIntro: Load a task another pilot shared by its XContest code, or publish yours to get a code XCTrack loads straight from the cloud.

cloudCode.expired: Expired on {date}. XCTrack can no longer load this code. Request a new one below.
cloudCode.stale: {kind, select, route {Route} other {Task}} edited since publishing, so this code still loads the older version. Republish to update the cloud copy.
cloudCode.validUntilDays: Valid until {date} · {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} left
cloudCode.inXctrack: In XCTrack: Task → Edit → Load from XContest, then enter this code. Permanent id {hash}.
cloudCode.signInRoute: Sign in to publish a cloud code. You can still download the route file and show its QR without an account.
cloudCode.signInTask: Sign in to publish a cloud code. You can still import one, download the .xctsk, and export a QR without an account.
cloudCode.routeNote: Route codes are not saved with the route: note it down or copy it before leaving the planner.
cloudCode.taskNote: Save the task to keep this code with it, otherwise it lives only in this session.

toasts.signIn: {kind, select, route {Sign in to publish a route to the XContest cloud.} other {Sign in to publish a task to the XContest cloud.}}
toasts.needWaypoints: Add at least two waypoints before publishing.
toasts.needTask: Finish the task (start + goal, no errors) before publishing.

PWCA.blurb: Paragliding World Cup rules: goal line, 1 km ESS.

validation.needStartAndGoal: A task needs at least a start and a goal.
validation.firstTurnpoint: The first turnpoint is usually the take-off or the start (SSS).
validation.noSss: No start of speed section (SSS) is set.
validation.goalNotLast: The goal should be the last turnpoint.
validation.noTimeGate: The start has no time gate yet. Set one before flying.
validation.gatesNotSorted: Start gates are not in chronological order.
validation.essBeforeGoalPwca: PWCA tasks usually set an ESS ~1 km before goal so pilots finish safely.
validation.essBeforeGoalFai: Section 7A recommends setting the ESS before goal to avoid racing low.
validation.elevatedGoalNeedsEss: An elevated goal usually needs an ESS before goal so pilots are timed before the climb to the gate.
validation.goalHeightHigh: Goal arrival height is {height} AGL, which is unusually high (it is height above the goal terrain, not AMSL).
validation.pwcaGoalLine: PWCA tasks default to a goal line, not a cylinder.
validation.pwcaGoalLineShort: Goal line is under the PWCA {min} minimum.

roleUnavailable.needSecondTurnpoint: Add a second turnpoint first: a task needs a start and a goal.
roleUnavailable.lastIsGoal: The last turnpoint is always the goal. Drag another point to the end to move the goal.
roleUnavailable.goalMustBeLast: The goal must be the last turnpoint. Drag this point to the end of the list.
roleUnavailable.startNeedsSuccessor: Add a turnpoint after this one first, otherwise the start (SSS) would have nowhere to go.
roleUnavailable.takeoffBeforeStart: The take-off has to come before the start (SSS).
roleUnavailable.essAfterStart: The ESS has to come after the start (SSS).
